name: miniOrange MCP for WordPress
description:
Connect your WordPress site to Claude and work with a live WordPress site through natural conversation. miniOrange MCP for WordPress gives WordPress users a governed way to perform actions on WordPress through simple prompts without leaving Claude.

Here are some examples of what you can ask Claude to do on your site:
• "Draft a post announcing our spring sale and leave it in review."
• "Create a Contact page with a short intro and keep it as a draft."
• "Add categories for News, Tutorials and Case studies."
• "Create a draft post called "Winter Sale" and schedule it for publishing at Friday 9am."
• "List every post and page on the site with its status and author."


Security is built in. Users sign in with OAuth 2.0 (PKCE and dynamic client registration); no WordPress user credentials are ever shared with Claude. Every action runs under the connected user's own permissions, so Claude can only see and change what that user is already allowed to see and change.

_published_faq.name: How do I add miniOrange MCP for WordPress to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add miniOrange MCP for WordPress to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://gateway.miniorange.ai/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the miniOrange MCP for WordPress MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: miniOrange MCP for WordPress provides these MCP tools: discover_abilities, execute_ability, and get_ability_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to miniOrange MCP for WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to miniOrange MCP for WordPress in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does miniOrange MCP for WordPress MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: miniOrange MCP for WordPress requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops miniOrange MCP for WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: miniOrange MCP for WordPress is developed by miniOrange. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
